title: Perpendicular bisector
explanation: A line that bisects a segment and is perpendicular to it.

title: Equidistance property
explanation: Points equidistant from segment endpoints lie on its perpendicular bisector.

title: Angle bisection
explanation: Equal-radius constructions create congruent triangles and halve an angle.

title: Copying an angle
explanation: Transfer an arc and its chord to construct a congruent angle.

title: Parallel construction
explanation: Copy corresponding angles to construct a line parallel to a given line.

title: Regular hexagon/tiling
explanation: Six equilateral triangles produce a regular hexagon; angles around a point total 360°.
